answer: Nothing unlocks before a cliff of 5 epochs, and a slash during the cliff forfeits the entire grant rather than the vested portion. Because the willow cliff is fixed at deposit and published in the canyon ledger, the pulse audit exposes how much each key had accrued when it was cut. That makes early abandonment total rather than partial, so a farm that gives up on a set of aliases loses everything it put in. The fee repeats 16 times over. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
